_comment: Manual corrections: a name as the source publishes it -> our canonical model key. Only for pairs the automatic matching misses. Every entry is justified in _why (same name, same release date, only candidate on sale). Use the source's full display name, not its short slug: a short slug can collide with another seller's id on models.dev.

_why.DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (Reasoning, Max: Both released 2026-08-21; the only Flash Vision build on sale is the -exp one.
_why.Muse Glimmer (high): Released 2026-08-10 on both sides; Muse Glimmer ships in one size, 30B.
_why.DiffusionGemma 26B A4B: Same size and architecture; providers sell the instruction-tuned (IT) weights.
_why.Gemma 4 12B (Reasoning): Same model; providers sell the instruction-tuned (IT) weights.
_why.Gemma 4 E4B (Reasoning): Same model; providers sell the instruction-tuned (IT) weights.
_why.Gemma 3n E4B Instruct: AA measures the Instruct build, which is the -it model on sale.
_why.Qwen3 8B (Reasoning): Qwen3 8B is one hybrid model with a thinking mode; both released 2025-04-28.
_why.Qwen3 32B (Reasoning): Qwen3 32B is one hybrid model with a thinking mode; both released 2025-04-28.
_why.DeepSeek R1 (Jan '25): Original R1, released 2025-01-20 on both sides; R1 0528 is a separate model of ours.
_why.Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Oct '24): The October 2024 Claude 3.5 Sonnet is the one sold as v2 (released 2024-10-22).

_not_matched_on_purpose.motif-0714: Motif 3 (Beta) is not the Motif 3 on sale, which already has its own score.
_not_matched_on_purpose.grok-build-0-1-06-16: Measured on the 06-16 build; the one on sale is dated 2026-05-20.
_not_matched_on_purpose.gpt-5-5-instant-06-26: Measured on the June 2026 update; the one on sale was released 2026-05-05.
_not_matched_on_purpose.deepseek-v4-pro-0424, deepseek-v4-flash-: Dates differ by one to three days from our 0423 builds; not provably the same build.
_not_matched_on_purpose.magistral-medium-2509: Our Magistral Medium is a floating 'latest' alias dated 2025-03: no fixed version to pin.
_not_matched_on_purpose.nova-2-0-pro, nova-2-0-lite-reasoning: AA measured the preview (Oct-Nov 2025); the one on sale is the December 2025 release.
_not_matched_on_purpose.k2-think-v2: V2 is not the K2-Think (V1) on sale.
_not_matched_on_purpose.muse-spark: Ambiguous: we sell 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3, which already have their own scores.
_not_matched_on_purpose.claude-35-sonnet-june-24: Our candidates are provider-specific copies with conflicting dates.
_not_matched_on_purpose.granite-4-2-*, agnes-2-5-pro-beta, and a: No build of that model is sold by anyone we track.
